item.description: LELAND, NC (WWAY) — McAllister’s Deli officially opened their new location in Leland at 1109 New Pointe Boulevard. Doors opened at 10 am with people lined outside in order to receive the free incentives being offered. item.title: Search for the Brown University shooter continues as questions swirl about campus security
